answer: Give every agent a vault it must climb, terrace by terrace. First, it locks 90 POA for 45 days. Second, each of three terraces demands it forge a new session key and finish a live 45-minute task countersigned by two staked peers, a terrace a week. Third, a missed deadline burns 15 POA and drops it one terrace; two misses freeze the vault 30 days. Fourth, a hardware fingerprint match on a second identity on the same device slashes the full 90 POA. Faking 1,000 agents costs 90,000 POA, 3,000 live tasks and 1,000 devices, like forging a thousand season tickets while ushers check every face.
